messages:
maria: quick copy + a11y pass on the modal that prompts users to snapshot before stopping an instance. product has seen confusion around 'stop' vs 'terminate' and wants clearer microcopy. screenshot attached. choi: noted. current language mixes 'stop', 'terminate', and 'shutdown' across flows. let's pick consistent verbs: 'Stop' for deallocating compute (volumes preserved), 'Terminate' for deleting the instance and attached resources. maria: agreed. users asked 'will my volumes be deleted?' so we need explicit sentence about volumes and billing in the modal body. also want a subtle CTA to nudge snapshots without making the modal heavy. dev-bot: implementation constraints: we should avoid autofocus on destructive buttons, ensure tabindex order matches visual order, and keep the snapshot action a button (not a link) so it's keyboard accessible. a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) initial focus on Cancel (or close) for destructive flows, 2) aria-describedby linking the primary to the explanatory paragraph, 3) announce balance/state if relevant using aria-live polite, 4) snapshot progress via aria-live. Also ensure contrast for colored buttons. product-bot: metrics: add events modal.snapshot_shown and modal.snapshot_clicked. i18n keys: modal.stop.title/body/snapshot_cta/primary/secondary. choi: draft copy: header 'Stop instance' body 'Stopping this instance will deallocate compute and stop billing. Attached volumes remain unless you explicitly delete them. Create a snapshot to save session state before stopping.' buttons: Cancel | Create snapshot | Stop instance (red) with aria-label 'Stop instance and end compute billing'. maria: wording tweak: change 'stop billing' -> 'stop compute billing' and 'Attached volumes remain' -> 'Attached volumes will remain intact'. also add inline doc link 'How snapshots work'. a11y-bot: confirm: primary Stop button should have aria-describedby pointing at the paragraph id so the full context is read by screen readers when the button receives focus. dev-bot: i'll add unit tests for aria-describedby and focus default equals Cancel. maria: great. small UX note: make Create snapshot appear before Stop in the button row so users see the safe option first. product wants the red Stop visually prominent but not focused. choi: final pasteable snippet for devs: ```

Stop instance

Stopping this instance will deallocate compute and stop compute billing. Attached volumes will remain intact unless you delete them. Create a snapshot to save session state before stopping. How snapshots work

``` maria: thanks everyone i'll update Figma and add copy to the PR. devs, please run the a11y checklist in staging before merge. :white_check_mark:
